findings.summary: DeepCopy of RoleInstanceSpec in newVersionedInstance prevents shared-slice aliasing of identity labels across ordinals.
InjectIdentityLabelsIntoComponents in InjectVersionedRoleInstanceSpec keeps per-ordinal identity when the whole spec is replaced by the shared template during in-place update.

UNCOVERED: no envtest asserts identity labels survive a real in-place pod image update on the running pod. Spec-level proof is F2; pod-level derivation is mechanical K8s (pod labels come from template) but unverified by integration.

Cause 1 (restart-policy upgrade fix): a no-backoff / legacy-string / type-only role keeps the deprecated restartPolicy string (RestartPolicyConfig nil), only a backoff-configured role writes the config; representation stable across two reconciles. PASS on fix; the three no-backoff cases FAIL when the fix is reverted to unconditional restartPolicyConfig.
